scenario: Table 1 D: one isolated overloaded partition
prerequisite: All eight core trials and both paired-family reports reviewed; dedicated one-partition calibration passed its predeclared checks. Remaining time and storage are checked by the launcher.
notes: This is a preliminary synthetic partition-sequential limitation case, not key-skew analysis, stateful output validation, a new selector, or novelty over prior work.

Producer code treats SKEW_PARTITION="0" as explicit partition 0. Every producer chooses it with probability 0.8; remaining messages choose among the other 59. Expected hot input is 1,200/s; actual acknowledged partition arrivals are measured.

One current owner processes the hot partition sequentially. Scaling may change its owner and that owner's performance; it does not split the partition across consumers. Record hot-owner changes and achieved throughput rather than assume the same service capacity on shared nodes.
Each production episode lasts 300 s, including 60 s excluded warm-up. Action is scheduled at production +120 s, leaving 180 s of continued production before a fixed 120 s drain.
Two matched seed pairs use opposite action orders. Do not pool this family with balanced trials or claim equal initial placement: ordinary assignor mappings and node placement are recorded.
Apply the same production freshness, guard, evidence, admission and per-metric coverage rules as core protocol-v4. Keep unfavorable results and interrupted diagnostics.
Unfinished messages remain alongside conditional completion latency. No recovery confirmed during production is censored. Backlog offsets are not distinct unfinished-cohort counts.

Prepare now; launch only after the core comparison prerequisite and the remaining-time/storage checks are satisfied. Stop at the same campaign deadline and reserve the final hour for restoration/reporting.

Revision 2 adds the completed dedicated capacity qualification before any concentrated-partition outcome. All four original trial configurations, durations, plans, seeds and order are unchanged. The calibration is one recorded node and interval; record the hot owner and node in each trial.
